headline.purpose: Page-level titles: Country Dashboard, Country Comparison, Europe Map (36px).

title.purpose: Section headers; a 600/17px compact variant covers in-card chart titles.

label.purpose: KPI eyebrow labels and sidebar section headers; not for marketing kickers.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow for ordinary card-shaped surfaces (secondary KPI cards, flip cards).

shadows.name: ambient-hero
shadows.purpose: Mid-weight prominent surfaces that don't rise to full Elevated treatment.

shadows.name: elevated
shadows.purpose: Layered tight+diffuse shadow for the one hero-weight surface per screen (home hero, live-overview strip, dashboard's lead KPI, comparison table). Never spread across a repeated grid.

shadows.name: rail-edge
shadows.purpose: Cast from the dark sidebar onto the light content area.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Clickable cards/rows on hover (pinned country cards, ranking rows), paired with a 2px translateY.

motion.name: flip-card
motion.purpose: Home-screen energy-type card flip; instant crossfade under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: progress-fill
motion.purpose: Investment-snapshot and ranking bars animate via scaleX(transform-origin: left), not width, to avoid layout thrash.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Standard easing for all state-change transitions (hover, active, focus).

breakpoints.name: sidebar-collapse
breakpoints.purpose: Below this, the dark sidebar collapses to a 76px icon-only rail; above it, the full 280px rail with labels/clock/hint shows.

breakpoints.name: stat-strip-dividers
breakpoints.purpose: Below this, the live-overview strip's stats wrap and vertical hairline dividers disable via .stat-strip-item's media query -- they only make visual sense side-by-side.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: The 'Back to map' navigation pill on the dashboard screen. Shared via the .pill-btn class in index.css.
components.css: .ds-pill-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: #12541d; background: #dde9df; border: 1px solid #dde3de; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill-btn:hover { background: #dde3de; } .ds-pill-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-pill-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #03bdc2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: KPI Card
components.description: A metric card with a category-colored top border, used four-up on the country dashboard. Static (non-interactive); no hover state by design.
components.html:
Wind capacity
💨
42,180MW
Onshore + offshore
components.css: .ds-kpi-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px 24px; border: 1px solid #dde3de; border-top: 4px solid #2563eb; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-kpi-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7280; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-kpi-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; background: #eff6ff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; color: #111827; line-height: 1; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-kpi-unit { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7280; margin-left: 4px; } .ds-kpi-sub { font-size: 12px; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Interactive Card
components.description: The clickable variant (pinned country cards, the flip card): Ambient Card at rest, Hover Lift + 2px translateY on hover, back to Ambient Card on press. Shared via .card-interactive in index.css. Uses role="button"/tabIndex/onKeyDown rather than a nested <button> when the card contains its own interactive child (e.g. an unpin control), since a <button> cannot legally contain another <button>.
components.css: .ds-card-interactive { cursor: pointer; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dde3de; border-radius: 16px; padding: 18px 20px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card-interactive:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-interactive:active { transform: translateY(0); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); } .ds-card-interactive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #03bdc2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; min-width: 34px; height: 24px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #e5e7eb; color: #374151; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-family: monospace; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #111827; margin-top: 6px; }

components.name: Country Select Input
components.description: The country switcher dropdown on the dashboard header. Shared via .select-field in index.css; has an explicit aria-label since there's no visible <label>.
components.css: .ds-select { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1.5px solid #dde3de; background: #ffffff; color: #111827; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); min-width: 160px; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-select:hover { border-color: #4d9d55; } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #03bdc2; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (dark rail)
components.description: Persistent nav item on the dark Charcoal rail; active state is a solid Sentry Teal fill, not an underline or side stripe. Collapses to icon-only below the lg breakpoint (title attribute carries the label in collapsed mode).
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; border: none; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; text-align: left; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; background: transparent; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #03bdc2; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-icon { color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item:not(.ds-nav-item--active) .ds-nav-icon { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }

components.name: Hero KPI Card
components.description: The dashboard's dominant KPI: Indigo Deep background, spans 2 grid columns beside 3 smaller secondary KPI cards, 52px Sentry-Teal numeral. Size + color + position all agree on what matters most -- the system's core answer to 'strong visual hierarchy'.
components.html:
Wind + solar total
⚡
63,989MW
Combined renewable capacity for this country
components.css: .ds-hero-kpi { grid-column: span 2; background: #192168; border-radius: 24px; padding: 32px 36px; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.14); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 168px; } .ds-hero-kpi-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-hero-kpi-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-hero-kpi-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 19px; } .ds-hero-kpi-value { font-size: 52px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; color: #03bdc2; } .ds-hero-kpi-unit { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-left: 8px; } .ds-hero-kpi-sub { font-size: 13px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: The sort toggle (Total / Wind / Solar) on the comparison screen: a Mist track holding borderless buttons, active option gets a white pill + small lift shadow + Forest weight-700 text. Use over loose toggle buttons for 2-4 mutually exclusive options.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: #f4f6f4; border: 1px solid #dde3de; border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px; } .ds-segmented-btn { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 9px; border: none; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: #6b7280; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-segmented-btn:hover { color: #111827; } .ds-segmented-btn[data-active="true"] { background: #ffffff; color: #12541d; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

components.name: Flip Card (front)
components.description: Home-screen energy-type card: a real <button> (not a div) with aria-pressed and an aria-label describing the flip action, 3D-rotateY flip on click, Indigo Deep front face with the icon in a soft rgba(255,255,255,0.06) circle. Uses Ambient Card shadow, not Elevated -- a repeated 6-card grid at hero-shadow weight would dilute the one-hero-per-screen hierarchy. Reduced-motion users get an instant flip instead of the 550ms rotation.
components.css: .ds-flip-btn { display: block; width: 100%; height: 236px; padding: 0; border: none; background: none; font: inherit; text-align: inherit; cursor: pointer; perspective: 1200px; } .ds-flip-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #03bdc2; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-flip-front { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; height: 100%; padding: 20px 24px; background: #192168; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); transition: transform 550ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-flip-icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 28px; } .ds-flip-title { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: -0.2px; margin: 0; } .ds-flip-desc { font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); margin: 0; } .ds-flip-cta { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; margin-top: 4px; }

narrative.overview: This is an instrument, not a brochure — and it reads as a sibling product to its parent brands rather than a standalone consumer eco-app. enevogroup.com and sentryot.com set the identity: corporate, credentials-forward, dark-neutral-led, with green (Enevo) or teal (SentryOT) as one disciplined accent rather than the dominant hue. The system has since committed harder to that identity: the sidebar is a dark Charcoal rail (not a light gradient), KPI rows lead with one visually dominant Indigo-Deep hero card instead of four equal cards, and section titles/hero numbers run bigger and bolder. This is amplification within the existing palette -- no new hues were introduced -- but it pushes further into premium-enterprise-data-product territory: strong hierarchy through scale and darkness contrast, generous spacing between sections, and a layered Elevated shadow reserved for the one hero-weight surface each screen leads with. It still explicitly rejects the eco-marketing playbook: no leaf illustrations, no gradient hero blobs, no stock-photo wind turbines, no hopeful-pastel color washes.
keyCharacteristics: Forest Green (Enevo's exact #12541d) is the primary brand signal; Sentry Teal (#03bdc2) is the one sanctioned secondary accent, and now also the 'hero number' glow color on dark surfaces (the sidebar clock, the dashboard's dominant KPI, the live-overview strip's renewable-share stat).
Dark corporate neutrals -- Indigo Deep and Charcoal -- now carry structural chrome (the sidebar) and hero moments (the home hero, the dashboard's lead KPI), not just decorative banners.
One dominant number per screen: the Hero KPI Card and the Instrument Strip pattern both lead with a single oversized stat before supporting detail.
Elevated (a layered tight+diffuse shadow) is reserved for exactly one hero-weight surface per screen -- never a repeated grid -- so 'premium' stays an exception that means something.
Grids reflow with repeat(auto-fit, minmax(_, 1fr)) instead of fixed column counts; the sidebar collapses to a 76px icon rail below the lg breakpoint.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Forest Green (matching Enevo Group) is the brand's primary signal color; Sentry Teal (matching SentryOT) is the sole secondary/interactive accent. Every other hue in the Tertiary set -- wind blue, solar amber, hydro cyan, geothermal red, biomass green, tidal sky, investment violet -- exists solely to encode a data category and must never be reused for UI chrome, buttons, or navigation.

rules.name: The Corporate Darks Rule
rules.body: Indigo Deep and Charcoal, both lifted from Enevo's own site, are the only sanctioned dark surfaces -- now carrying structural chrome (the sidebar rail) as well as hero moments, not just decorative banners.

rules.name: The Sibling-Brand Font Rule
rules.body: Typography matches Enevo Group's own choice (Roboto) rather than an unrelated product font. Installed as @fontsource/roboto, weights 300/400/500/700, imported in main.tsx.

rules.name: The One Elevated Surface Per Screen Rule
rules.body: Within a screen's own content, the Elevated shadow marks exactly one dominant surface (the dashboard's lead KPI, the comparison table, the home hero) -- never a repeated grid (flip cards use Ambient Card, not Elevated) and never two content cards at equal weight. The persistent live-overview strip is the one exception, since it's cross-screen chrome rather than that screen's content.

rules.name: The Inline-Beats-Class Rule
rules.body: An inline style property always overrides an external CSS rule for that same property, :hover or not. Any element that needs both a per-instance dynamic color AND a class-driven hover/active state must pass the color through a CSS custom property (style={{'--x': value}}) so the class body -- not an inline declaration -- owns the actual background/border/color, leaving :hover free to win.

rules.name: The Side-By-Side-Only Rule
rules.body: Visual devices that only make sense between adjacent items (the live-overview strip's vertical dividers) must disable via a CSS media query, not stay in inline styles, once the layout can wrap to a single column -- otherwise a wrapped item keeps a dangling divider line that borders nothing.

dos: Do treat Forest (#12541d) as the primary brand signal and Sentry Teal (#03bdc2) as the only secondary/interactive accent; keep the Tertiary data palette exclusively for chart and category encoding.
Do keep the map/chart palette colorblind-safe -- pair color with icons or text labels the way the KPI cards already do (icon + label + color), never color alone.

Do give every interactive element hover, focus, and (where it applies) active states -- reach for the shared classes in index.css (.pill-btn, .segmented-btn, .select-field, .card-interactive, .row-interactive, .icon-btn, .pin-btn) and the global :focus-visible rule before writing a new one-off.
Do route per-instance dynamic colors through CSS custom properties when the element also needs a class-driven hover/active state.
Do use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(_, 1fr)) for card/chart grids instead of a fixed column count.
Do make every clickable non-button element (a card, a table row) keyboard-operable: tabIndex={0}, an onKeyDown handler for Enter/Space, and an aria-label.
Do lead each screen's primary content with one dominant surface (the Hero KPI Card, the Elevated table) rather than a row of equal-weight cards.
Do disable side-by-side-only visual devices (dividers) via a CSS media query, not inline styles, when the layout can wrap.
donts: Don't drift back to the bright, all-green "eco app" wash this system started as -- Forest is one accent among dark corporate neutrals now, not the dominant hue.
Don't introduce generic green/eco marketing aesthetics: leaf illustrations, gradient hero blobs, or stock nature photography (per PRODUCT.md's anti-references).
Don't use alarm-driven red framing as a default; Error Red is reserved strictly for actual fetch/data failures.
Don't use Sentry Teal for data encoding -- it's reserved for interactive/info UI chrome; Hydro Cyan remains the only cyan-family data color.
Don't add new one-off dark surfaces. Indigo Deep and Charcoal are the only two; nothing else should be invented.
Don't reference a font family string that isn't an installed dependency.
Don't animate width/height for progress-style fills -- use transform: scaleX() with transform-origin: left (the .progress-fill class) so the browser skips layout.
Don't nest a real <button> inside another <button> for a clickable-card-with-inner-action pattern -- invalid HTML. Use role="button" + tabIndex + onKeyDown on the outer element instead.
Don't apply the Elevated shadow to a repeated grid -- it's reserved for the one hero-weight surface per screen; spread across many cards it stops reading as premium and just looks heavy.

Don't ship the current placeholder brand assets as final: favicon.svg is a generic purple lightning-bolt icon unrelated to the brand, and icons.svg is leftover Vite-template cruft with no live usage -- replace or remove before this is considered launch-ready.
